data.name: Harness Ally
data.description: As a swift action, you can expend your psionic focus and use the visual and auditory senses of one member of your collective for one round.  In that round, you can manifest a power and can select a target for the power if it is eligible to the chosen member of the collective.  The power then uses that collective member's line of sight and line of effect to determine eligible targets.  The member of the collective selected must be within  100 feet of you to use this ability.
